name: golden
description: Everyday tickets with known-correct triage. Grow it from production failures (./run-evals.sh promote).

ticket.message: Hi, my headphones arrived with a cracked left ear cup. I'd like my money back please. - Priya

cases.referenceReply: Apologises for the damaged headphones, confirms a full refund of $89.00 to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.

ticket.message: I bought a smartwatch and honestly I just don't use it. Can I return it for a refund?

cases.referenceReply: Kindly explains refunds are only possible within 30 days of delivery and this order was delivered 45 days ago, so it isn't eligible; offers to connect them with a human agent. No store credit or exception promised.

ticket.message: The keyboard I ordered has two keys that don't register. I want a refund.

cases.referenceReply: Apologises for the faulty keys, confirms the order is within the 30-day window and approves a full refund of $64.50 within 5-7 business days.

ticket.message: My webcam stopped working yesterday. Please refund me, it's barely a month old!

cases.referenceReply: Empathises, explains the 30-day refund window has passed (delivered 31 days ago) so a refund isn't possible, offers to connect them with a human agent for other options.

ticket.message: I was charged twice for the same order! Two payments of $45.99 on my statement. Fix this.

cases.referenceReply: Apologises for the double charge, confirms the duplicate $45.99 payment will be refunded to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.

ticket.message: My order was supposed to arrive last week and it still hasn't come. Where is it? If it doesn't come I want a refund.

cases.referenceReply: Apologises for the delay, explains we'll look into the shipment, and that a refund can't be issued by the assistant while the order hasn't been delivered.

ticket.message: Someone changed my account email and password and placed an order I didn't make. Please help!!

cases.referenceReply: Takes it seriously, says the security team is taking over urgently, advises not to share passwords or codes with anyone; no refund promised by the assistant.

ticket.message: There's a charge from ShopNest on my card that I don't recognise. I never ordered anything this month.

cases.referenceReply: Reassures, says a specialist will investigate the unrecognised charge urgently, asks them not to share card details in chat.

ticket.message: Our whole warehouse team can't log into the ShopNest Business portal since 9am. Orders are piling up. This is blocking production.

cases.referenceReply: Acknowledges the business impact, says the issue is escalated urgently to the engineering/on-call team, sets expectation of a quick update.

ticket.message: The wishlist page in the app shows a blank screen on my Android phone.

cases.referenceReply: Thanks them, acknowledges the blank wishlist screen on Android, suggests a basic step (update app / clear cache) and says the team will look into it.

ticket.message: How do I download a VAT invoice for my order? I need it for my company expenses.

cases.referenceReply: Explains how to find and download the invoice for the order (e.g. from the order history / account orders page). Short and helpful.

ticket.message: Would be great if you had a dark mode in the app. Any plans?

cases.referenceReply: Thanks them for the suggestion, says it's passed to the product team, no promises about dates.

ticket.message: I forgot my password and the reset email never arrives. I can't get into my account to track my order.

cases.referenceReply: Empathises, suggests checking spam and retrying the reset, offers further help; never asks for the password.

ticket.message: This laptop overheats and shut down during my exam. If I don't get a full refund today I'm calling my lawyer.

cases.referenceReply: Calm and empathetic, confirms the order is within the window and eligible for a full $1249.00 refund, and that a senior agent is taking over the ticket. No legal advice, no guarantees.

ticket.message: THIS IS THE WORST STORE EVER. The charger you sent melted. MELTED. Give me my money back NOW.

cases.referenceReply: Stays calm, apologises sincerely, treats the melted charger as a safety concern (advises to stop using it), confirms a full $29.99 refund within 5-7 business days.

ticket.message: Hola, el ratón que compré llegó roto. Quiero un reembolso, por favor.

cases.referenceReply: Replies in Spanish, apologises for the broken mouse, confirms a full refund of $24.00 within 5-7 business days.
